title: Frank Dusen's Eagle Band, Joe Oliver and Willie Cornish
summary: He played with Frank Dusen's Eagle Band after Bolden, remembers Joe Oliver sitting in on Saturday nights, and Willie Cornish continuing in brass bands.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I see. One other question. Mettoyer, did you tell me you played with Bolden sometimes, do you? When you were very young, you played with Bolden?

Well, after Frank, long after, I played with Frank. Frank had a band. It was gone. Frank had changed his band name. It's called his band name, The Eagle Band. Well, he had Buddy. Played with Buddy on his job. I said Elizabeth Hall. Frank had a Masonic Hall every Saturday night. That was Rampart and Padilla. Frank had a Masonic Hall. He was blown, but going off. That play, he wouldn't stop sometimes. Then Frank leaves him going. He got sick then. That's why they kept him home. They just sent him out and all the tensed of them. Then Frank taking a fellow they called Edouard Clem. He was a one-eyed fellow. He was from a reserve of the country. Then Edouard played with Frank. Frank leaves Edouard go. Joe used to come around on Saturday night. Joe was working Butler for White people out front of town, but always studying music. Joe would come around on a Saturday night dressed up and always treat the band. He'd treat the fellas. Treat Frank, you know. And Frank would leave him play a number. Was he very good then? Could Joe play trumpet all right? Yeah, Joe could play pretty good. He was strong. And he could read. That's what Frank liked it. So Frank taking him in the band. You mean instead of Bolden? Oh, Bolden, that's after Bolden. After Bolden. After Bolden, yeah. After Bolden. After Bolden, yeah.
I was wondering about Carnish. When he stopped playing with Bolden, did he stop playing music, or did he keep on playing after that? Willie Carnish on trombone. Did he keep on working around here?
Yeah, a couple of them should play sometimes. He played with the Little Tuxedo Brass Band. He kept on working. Yeah, he'd play in the Brass Band like that. And catch a job like that he'd play.
